_note: Every tag id the seed has ever shipped that the merged 85-tag taxonomy no longer holds, mapped to its equivalent in scripts/seed/tags/tags.json, or to null where no honest equivalent exists. Keys are the 56-id draft's retired ids plus four older Core ids. The one map: migrate-to-draft-taxonomy.py repoints the JSON seeds through it, build_sql.py writes it into tags.sql, and run.ts applies it, so a database seeded from an older list has its selections and event links moved across and the retired tags removed. null means a selection on that id is dropped: other-languages spans several languages, crafts-textiles and yoga-meditation each split across two or more tags, and the three campus ids have no counterpart.
